name: CzechVR
summary: Prague-based VR specialist prized by headset enthusiasts for razor-sharp 8K optical clarity, natural eye-line framing, and a 3-site European network.
ranking_rationale: A technical favorite among VR purists for tack-sharp 8K encoding, natural lighting, and attentive eye contact across its three cohesive Czech VR lines.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; network access covers CzechVR, CzechVR Fetish, and CzechVR Casting. Check official checkout.
